$description: Validation rules for happycampr carousel rendering. A renderer MUST fail the build on any contract violation. Companion to carousel.manifest.json and design-tokens.json. Colour/logo values resolve via design-tokens.json; four-colour-palette compromises are logged in design/ambiguous.md §13.

safeZones.$description: Hard minimums in pixels. Violating produces the 'AI slop' look.

shape-to-rule.applies: Any decorative shape edge to any hairline rule

text-to-rule.applies: Text descender bottom to any rule. Must add descender depth (see descenderFormula).

shape-to-text.applies: Edge-to-edge between a shape and a text block

text-to-text.applies: Between adjacent text blocks of the same semantic group (headline → body)

group-to-group.applies: Between semantically distinct groups (caption → code block)

lineHeight.$description: Floors to prevent ascender/descender collision in Inter.

title.applies: Multi-line headlines at title or title-sm size

display.allowedCondition: single-line OR descender-bearing letters (g, j, p, q, y) fall on the last line only

descenderFormula.$description: Minimum baseline-to-rule clearance for text sitting above a rule.

warningFullChroma.$note: happycampr has no amber. warning + warning-text both map to graham (#946334), which is WCAG AA body / AAA large on marshmallow. See design/ambiguous.md §13.1.

color.$paletteNote: happycampr is four flat colours. chromaticColors resolve to graham (primary/warning) + moss (secondary); complement collapses to burnt/ink. Only two truly chromatic colours exist — honour the contrast rule: never Burnt-on-Moss or Graham-on-Moss for text. See design/ambiguous.md §13.
color.chartPlotAreaException: The chart plot area of a plate-chart slide is exempt from maxChromaticPerSlide and may use the ordered chart.seriesPalette. The rest of the slide — and all axis/label text — still obeys this rule and stays ink/ink-dim. See #chart.plotAreaChromaticException.

grid.applies: All vertical positions (baselines, rule y-coords, shape top/bottom) must be multiples of 8

twoColumnLandscape.$description: Optional editorial two-column body for landscape body plates. When used, both columns must be the same width (720), share a 96 px gutter, and align to the same baseline grid. Title plates and code plates do NOT use this — they remain single-column.

stylesheets.$description: External-resource allow-list. Slide HTML is otherwise self-contained (inline <style>). Only these may be linked; external JavaScript is always forbidden.
stylesheets.forbidden: any other external CSS; any external JavaScript; any unpinned or non-jsDelivr Charts.css URL
rejectIf: Any external stylesheet that is not Google Fonts or the pinned Charts.css URL → fail
Charts.css linked without the @1.2.0 version pin (floating tag) → fail

chart.$description: Hard rules for plate-chart slides. Engine is Charts.css (pure CSS). Enumerated mirror of carousel-manifest.md §12a and carousel.manifest.json#chart.

rejectIf: Chart drawn with inline <svg> or <canvas> instead of a Charts.css <table> → fail
Any JavaScript used to build, populate, or animate the chart → fail
Charts.css stylesheet missing, unpinned, or from a non-approved origin → fail (see #stylesheets)

requires: tbody with <tr> rows, each leading with <th scope="row">
one <td> per series carrying an inline --size in 0..1

box.$description: The chart <table> bounding box must fit inside the active orientation's contentArea, which is already inset 40 px from the rules, so shape-to-rule is auto-satisfied. With a headline, the top of the box is >= headlineGapPx below the headline's last line.

plotAreaChromaticException.$description: The chart plot area is the one documented exception to color.maxChromaticPerSlide. Do NOT reject a multi-series chart for using >2 chromatic colors inside the plot area, provided every series color comes from seriesPalette in order. The rest of the slide and all axis/label text still obey color.maxChromaticPerSlide.

rejectIf: Series color not from seriesPalette, or palette order skipped → fail
Chart box overflows the contentArea, or any box edge off the 8 px grid → fail
Axis/grid line not ink/ink-dim, or thicker than 1 px → fail
Axis or data label below 14 px, or not Inter, or not ink/ink-dim → fail
Any forbidden Charts.css component (3D, animation/motion, tooltip, hover-only data) → fail
Charts.css default palette/spacing left un-overridden (off-brand) → fail

branding.$description: happycampr is currently the only brand. Theming is future work — see carousel.manifest.json#branding.themingFutureWork. Every slide must include the header logo.

variantBySurface.$description: The lockup ships in two colourways that differ by WORDMARK colour. Select the one whose WORDMARK (the 'happycampr' letters) contrasts with the slide background — that is the part that must stay readable. Do NOT decide by the small mark/accent. Both files are copied into the slide dir; reference the matching one. The wordmark must NEVER blend into its background.
variantBySurface.rule: Light/marshmallow background → happycampr-logo.svg (burnt wordmark, contrasts on light). Dark/burnt surface-inverse background (e.g. takeaway) → happycampr-logo-inverse.svg (marshmallow wordmark, contrasts on dark).

position.$note: Top in px is fixed at 24 in both orientations because chrome is type-driven. Left equals the orientation's `marginX` (96 vertical / 128 landscape).

size.$note: happycampr lockup native viewBox 1080×220 (aspect 54:11). At 24px height the width is 24 × 1080/220 ≈ 118 px. See design/ambiguous.md §13.5.

rejectIf: Logo missing or broken (img 404, no src) → fail
Logo placed somewhere other than top-left header slot → fail
Logo height > 32 px or < 16 px (must be 24 with native aspect) → fail
Logo bottom edge less than 8 px above topRule → fail

Wordmark does not contrast with the background → fail: burnt-wordmark lockup (happycampr-logo.svg) on a burnt/dark surface, or marshmallow-wordmark lockup (happycampr-logo-inverse.svg) on a marshmallow/light surface. The 'happycampr' letters must be clearly legible — if the wordmark blends into the background (even if a small mark/accent is still visible) it is a fail (see variantBySurface).
Recolored, inverted-by-CSS-filter, or traced logo → fail; reference one of the two shipped lockup SVGs unmodified (the burnt and marshmallow colourways are the only canonical variants)

canvas.$description: Per-orientation hard dimensions. Renderer fails if body width/height for the active orientation does not match exactly.
